architecture_review.ownership: AssetLibrary owns physical asset publication; platform submits goals and reads authorized projections; coordinator alone publishes cross-product contracts.
architecture_review.dependency_direction: Test HTTP client calls the existing host. Host, Application, Domain and database module boundaries are unchanged.
architecture_review.test_only_logic: Candidate schema and relationship oracle check a proposal; no analyzer, production adapter, file executor or fake successful business endpoint was added.
architecture_review.test_tool: jsonschema 4.26.0 in owned ignored virtual environment; exact resolved versions recorded in tests.md
architecture_review.file_safety: Synthetic originals only; actual Core scans preserve SHA256/mtime; test-only physical operation fixtures are isolated and removed.
architecture_review.permissions: Real Core session, CSRF, Origin and library visibility exercised; platform service-to-library identity mapping is a separate missing capability.
architecture_review.performance: Bounded 100-item HTTP pages; 500k asset performance not verified.
architecture_review.compatibility: No application or released wire changes. Candidate shape has no callable production endpoint.
architecture_review.risks_and_followups: See next-task.md: authenticated read adapter, actual bounded dedup candidates, then independently gated durable plans and publication. Sandbox stores/ports do not prove production durability or authorization.
